ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: There are three ideal op-amps in the circuit. The upper and lower two op-amps on the left form the input stage: the non-inverting terminal of the upper op-amp is connected to V2, and the non-inverting terminal of the lower op-amp is connected to V1; the two inverting input nodes are connected by a 2R resistor; each left-side op-amp has an R resistor fed back from its own output to the inverting input node. Let the output of the upper-left op-amp be x, and the output of the lower-left op-amp be y. The right-side op-amp forms a differential amplification stage: x is connected through R to the inverting terminal of the right-side op-amp, and the output Vo is fed back through R to the inverting terminal; y is connected through R to the non-inverting terminal, and the non-inverting terminal is also connected to ground through R. Reasoning: Under linear negative feedback, an ideal op-amp has virtual short and zero input current. Therefore the voltage of the inverting node of the upper-left op-amp is equal to V2, and the voltage of the inverting node of the lower-left op-amp is equal to V1. Write KCL for the upper-left inverting node: (V2 - x)/R + (V2 - V1)/(2R) = 0, solving gives x = (3V2 - V1)/2. Write KCL for the lower-left inverting node: (V1 - y)/R + (V1 - V2)/(2R) = 0, solving gives y = (3V1 - V2)/2. In the right-side op-amp, all related resistors are R, so it is a unity-gain differential stage; the voltage at the non-inverting terminal is y/2 after y is divided by two equal R resistors, and the inverting terminal is also y/2. KCL at the inverting terminal gives (y/2 - x)/R + (y/2 - Vo)/R = 0, so Vo = y - x. Substituting x and y: Vo = (3V1 - V2)/2 - (3V2 - V1)/2 = 2(V1 - V2).

raw_record.question_text: Given that the op-amps in the circuit shown are ideal, what is the output voltage \(V_o\) in terms of \(V_1\) and \(V_2\)?

method.method_draft: First describe the circuit topology from the image, then assign symbols x and y to the upper and lower left op-amp outputs. Apply virtual short on the two left op-amps so their inverting nodes equal V2 and V1, respectively, and use KCL through the feedback R resistors and the connecting 2R resistor to solve for x and y. Then analyze the right op-amp as a unity-gain differential amplifier with all resistors equal to R: its output equals the lower input y minus the upper input x. Substitute the derived x and y to obtain Vo=2(V1−V2).
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：电路中有三个理想运放。左侧上、下两个运放构成输入级：上方运放的同相端接 V2，下方运放的同相端接 V1；两个反相输入节点之间由一个 2R 电阻连接；每个左侧运放都有一个 R 电阻从自身输出反馈到反相输入节点。设左上运放输出为 x，左下运放输出为 y。右侧运放构成差分放大级：x 经过 R 接到右侧运放反相端，输出 Vo 通过 R 反馈到反相端；y 经过 R 接到同相端，同相端还通过 R 接地。

推理：理想运放在线性负反馈下有虚短、输入电流为零。因此左上运放反相节点电压等于 V2，左下运放反相节点电压等于 V1。对左上反相节点列 KCL： (V2 - x)/R + (V2 - V1)/(2R) = 0，解得 x = (3V2 - V1)/2。对左下反相节点列 KCL： (V1 - y)/R + (V1 - V2)/(2R) = 0，解得 y = (3V1 - V2)/2。右侧运放中所有相关电阻均为 R，因此它是单位增益差分级；同相端电压为 y 经两个相等 R 分压后的 y/2，反相端也为 y/2。反相端 KCL 给出 (y/2 - x)/R + (y/2 - Vo)/R = 0，所以 Vo = y - x。代入 x 和 y：Vo = (3V1 - V2)/2 - (3V2 - V1)/2 = 2(V1 - V2)。
